valueChange.when: The user edits the value (typing, pasting, deleting) while the textarea is neither disabled nor readonly.

rules: input holds a multi-line value inside container: text wraps at the inline edge, explicit line breaks are kept, and Enter inserts a line break (it never submits a form).

The accessible name is the label of the enclosing Field, otherwise the label prop; one of them is present and non-empty. label is not displayed. placeholder is an example of the expected value in placeholderColor, shown only while the value is empty; it is never the accessible name and never replaces a label.

The text is set in typography with paddingInline on both inline sides (the padding of an InputText of the same size) and a block padding equal to half of minHeight minus one line of typography, so that a one-row textarea has the block size of an InputText of the same size and its text sits at the same position.

The container fills the inline size it is given. Its initial block size shows rows lines plus the block padding. resize vertical: the user can change the block size, never below one line nor in the inline direction. resize auto: the block size follows the content from rows to maxRows lines, then the content scrolls; the user cannot resize. resize none: the block size stays at rows lines and the content scrolls. maxRows applies only to auto. The interaction target meets minTarget in the block dimension without enlarging the visible container.
Paint container in surface with a border of borderWidth in border inside its boundary, corners of radius, and the value in content.
Resolve condition in this order: disabled, readonly, invalid, focus, hover, default. focus is an independent axis: an invalid textarea keeps the invalid colors while focused.

When focus is true, whatever the input modality, draw a focus indicator of focusWidth in focusColor at focusOffset outside the container, with corners of focusRadius (radius plus focusOffset), in addition to the condition colors.

Disabled removes the textarea from sequential focus; its value cannot be edited, selected or submitted. Readonly keeps it focusable and scrollable; its value can be selected and copied and is submitted, but cannot be edited. Neither emits valueChange.

Invalid and required are exposed to assistive technology. The visible explanation of an error and the required marker belong to the enclosing Field: an invalid textarea is placed in a Field with a message, so that an error is never conveyed by color alone.
Emit valueChange on every user edit; a value set by the application does not emit it. The component neither limits nor counts characters.
Color changes between conditions transition over motionDuration with easingStandard; the focus indicator appears without delay; no transition when reduced motion is requested.

In forced-colors mode the container keeps a visible boundary in the system field colors, the placeholder stays distinguishable from a value, the disabled textarea uses the system disabled text color and the focus indicator stays visible.
